# arianet_plans (Data Source)

Active server plans (`GET /cloud/v1/plans`), optionally of one datacenter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "arianet_plans" "fra" {
  datacenter = "eu-central-1"
}

locals {
  small = [for p in data.arianet_plans.fra.plans : p if p.vcpu == 2 && p.available][0]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `datacenter` (String) Only plans of this datacenter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this lookup.
- `plans` (Attributes List) The plans. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))

<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) Whether the plan can be ordered now (not sold out).
- `currency` (String) Currency.
- `datacenter` (String) Datacenter.
- `disk_gb` (Number) Disk in GB.
- `group` (String) Plan group key.
- `hourly_price` (Number) Hourly price.
- `id` (Number) Plan ID (`arianet_server.plan_id`).
- `monthly_price` (Number) Monthly price.
- `name` (String) Name.
- `ram_mb` (Number) Memory in MB.
- `recommended` (Boolean) Whether the plan is recommended.
- `traffic_gb` (Number) Included traffic in GB; null when unmetered.
- `vcpu` (Number) vCPUs.
